questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: The concept of "Directive Principles of State Policy" was borrowed from which country?
questions.explanation: The Directive Principles were borrowed from the Irish Constitution.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.A: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.explanation: Article 32 is called the "heart and soul" of the Constitution.

questions.question: Mount Everest is located in which country?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest lies on the Nepal–China border, with its peak in Nepal.

questions.question: Which Indian city is known as the "Pink City"?
questions.explanation: Jaipur is known as the Pink City.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India?
questions.explanation: The RBI is headquartered in Mumbai.

questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award.

questions.question: Who was the first President of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President (1950–62).

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Constitution of:
questions.explanation: The idea of a Preamble was borrowed from the US Constitution.

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Do or Die"?
questions.explanation: Gandhi gave "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: The author of the Indian national anthem is:
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote "Jana Gana Mana".

questions.question: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is the:
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: The Vice-President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the:
questions.explanation: The Vice-President chairs the Rajya Sabha.

questions.question: How many players are there in a kabaddi team on the court?
questions.explanation: A kabaddi team has 7 players on the court.

questions.question: How many players are there in a cricket team on the field?
questions.explanation: A cricket team fields 11 players.

questions.question: Which is the largest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest Indian state by area.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons in the solar system.

questions.question: Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: Which acid is present in the human stomach?
questions.explanation: The stomach uses hydrochloric acid for digestion.

questions.question: Which is the densest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: The minimum age to become the President of India is:
questions.explanation: A presidential candidate must be at least 35 years old.

questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which earlier body?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

questions.question: The Sundarbans delta is formed by which rivers?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans is formed by the Ganga–Brahmaputra delta.

questions.question: "Vidhan Sabha" refers to the:
questions.explanation: Vidhan Sabha is the State Legislative Assembly.

questions.question: Which schedule of the Constitution deals with anti-defection?
questions.explanation: The 10th Schedule contains the anti-defection provisions.

questions.question: In which sport is the term "googly" used?
questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The human heart has 4 chambers.

questions.question: Which line divides the Earth into Northern and Southern hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator divides the Earth into two hemispheres.

questions.question: How many members can the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The President nominates 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for expertise in arts, science, etc.

questions.question: Which is the largest freshwater lake in India?
questions.explanation: Wular Lake in Jammu & Kashmir is the largest freshwater lake in India.

questions.question: The Jog Falls is located on which river?
questions.explanation: Jog Falls is on the Sharavati river in Karnataka.

questions.question: The "Sun Temple" at Konark is located in which state?
questions.explanation: The Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: The term of a member of the Lok Sabha is normally:
questions.explanation: A Lok Sabha term is normally 5 years.

questions.question: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
questions.explanation: Vitamin K is required for blood clotting.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: The Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as the:
questions.explanation: It is called the Harappan Civilisation after Harappa, its first excavated site.

questions.question: The national song of India is:
questions.explanation: "Vande Mataram" is the national song; "Jana Gana Mana" is the national anthem.

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
questions.explanation: Common salt is sodium chloride, NaCl.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 56. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 56/7 = 8. Larger = 5 × 8 = 40.

questions.question: A train 180 m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/24 = 36/288. Time = 288/36 = 8 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm².

questions.question: Find the value of √576.
After a 20% discount, an item costs ₹640. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 20% of 700.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 9 and their difference is 24. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 4 parts = 24, so each part = 6. Smaller = 5 × 6 = 30.

questions.question: A boat travels 22 km downstream in 2 hours. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 22/2 = 11 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 11 − 4 = 7 km/h.

questions.question: Find the value of ∛512.
A train 150 m long crosses a platform 90 m long in 12 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 150 + 90 = 240 m in 12 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.

An article costing ₹260 is sold at a 5% profit. Find the selling price.

Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their sum is 63. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 63/7 = 9. Larger = 4 × 9 = 36.

questions.question: A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 6 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
If today is Friday, what day will it be after 66 days?
questions.explanation: 66 mod 7 = 3; Friday + 3 = Monday.

questions.question: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 11th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 11th letter = K; 11 + 4 = 15th letter = O.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (6, 216), (2, 7), (7, 343), (8, 512)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 2³ = 8, not 7.

questions.question: In a row of 57 students, Ravi is 8th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 57 − 8 + 1 = 50.

questions.question: Find the next term: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 4²…8². Next is 9² = 81.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 8, 14, 21, 29, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 1 each step; next difference is 9, so 29 + 9 = 38.

questions.question: If SUN is coded as UWP, how is PEN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to PEN gives RGP.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 5:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 5:00 the angle is 5 × 30° = 150°.
The relation is squaring: 11² = 121, so 12² = 144.

questions.question: A person walks 8 km East and then 15 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(8² + 15²) = √289 = 17 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 4 + 5 × 4.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 4 × 5 − 4 = 20 − 4 = 16.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 10, 20, 40, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 40 × 2 = 80.

questions.question: Complete the series: E, H, K, N, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is Q.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 20, 13, 19, 31
questions.explanation: 19, 31, 13 are prime numbers; 20 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 10th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 10th letter from the right is the 17th from the left = Q.
The relation is cubing: 6³ = 216, so 2³ = 8.

questions.question: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be after 45 days?
questions.explanation: 45 mod 7 = 3; Tuesday + 3 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 6th to the right of the 7th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 7th letter = G; 7 + 6 = 13th letter = M.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (8, 512), (5, 125), (4, 67), (7, 343)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 4³ = 64, not 67.

questions.question: In a row of 42 students, Ravi is 33rd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 42 − 33 + 1 = 10.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 3²…7². Next is 8² = 64.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 3, 8, 16, 27, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 14, so 27 + 14 = 41.

questions.question: If FISH is coded as JMWL, how is PEN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to PEN gives TIR.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 12² = 144.
